_about: Per-step wall-time budgets (ms) for tests/test_gui_journeys.py. Budget = 1.5 x the measured time, floor 50 ms. Steps that do the same work as before the GUI refactor use the synchronous code's time (gui_timings_before.json, 2026-10-18, 2e9b3dc + harness 5fb8fed); steps that now do new work use the refactored code's time (gui_timings_after.json, the slower of two runs, 2026-10-18). Measured on Charles's Windows 11 desktop; SCRAPPYFIT_BUDGET_SCALE scales them for other machines. Fit steps re-measured on fix/fit-speed 2026-10-20 (bit-identical fits; tools/golden_dump.py).
